audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 through 6 of the level chart say the opposite of their own why-text and of the packet. win[2] and win[3] say Illaoi while their whys read 'his passive shield and kite keep him ahead' and 'he pokes you out through levels 4-5'; win[4] says Akshan while its why reads 'your R tentacle wall and E finally punish his swing at 6'; win[5] says Illaoi while its why literally begins 'Skill:'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Illaoi, Skill, Akshan — exactly what the whys describe. The side/win fields were stamped from a template and never reconciled.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Illaoi, Skill, Akshan, proposed as one atomic group with phases[N].side and win[N] paired.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why was generic template text with no cooldown attached, so the one stage you actually own — level 6 — was not distinguishable from the four you do not.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and is the whole reason he survives levels 1-5; Leap of Faith at 6 plus a landed Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1) is the single window where his HP pool loses.
audit.corrected: Phases now name Heroic Swing's 18s, Avengerang's 850 range, and the level-6 window explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that decide this lane were entirely absent, and the page instead repeats 'track Heroic Swing' eleven times.
audit.why: First, Riot's text on Heroic Swing says he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain' — your body stops the swing, so standing in the arc is the counterplay, not dodging it. Second, Comeuppance deals damage to the FIRST champion, minion or structure hit, so a single caster minion between you eats the whole ultimate. Third, Test of Spirit says the target becomes a Vessel if it gets too far from the spirit — the kiting that beats your slams is what turns him into a tentacle farm.
audit.corrected: Body-block the swing, keep the wave between you and his R, and let him run from the spirit — that is a Vessel, not an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: Going Rogue's camouflage is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Illaoi's kit carries no revealsStealth flag, so she has no answer in her own abilities. Going Rogue is also a 5500-range mobility tool on a cooldown that falls to 2s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Control Wards and a sweeper are a requirement in this lane, not a preference — stated in report[5] and the level 3-5 spike.

edits.before: Plant tentacles before contesting anything. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Plant tentacles before contesting anything. Avengerang matches your Q at 850 and extends off every minion it clips.

edits.before: Landing E changes the lane — his soul fuels your field. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: He orbits your tentacles at 2 — Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1, so step up only once you have watched it go.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His shield and kite keep him ahead. Stand in his swing path — colliding with a champion knocks him off it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Swing's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He pokes you out through 4-5. Step up only with the wave between you: Comeuppance hits the first thing in its path, minions included.

edits.before: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your window at 6: Leap of Faith drops a tentacle per champion hit and a landed E punishes his swing. Bait the swing, then leap.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: Skill: it hinges on landing E through his mobility. Run from the spirit and he becomes a Vessel anyway.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akshan carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Akshan's item poke and roaming out-tempo you late — carry threat 7.5/10. Close the game before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs terrain to hook and is 18s at rank 1 — engage the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is down 16s at rank 1 — disengage, do not chase.

edits.before: Fighting in open ground with no tentacles — Illaoi without her field is the weakest juggernaut in the game.
edits.after: Tentacles are your damage and your heal — keep Q up so he breaks them under your idol, not for free.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Going Rogue is camouflage and you have no reveal — Control Ward the bushes. Heroic Swing breaks on colliding with a champion.

edits.before: Rough stretch: Akshan's W Going Rogue mobility and E Heroic Swing let him orbit around your tentacles, dodging slams while stacking his passive for a shield and burst. He pokes with Q Avengerang through minions and never has to stand in your E range, so you eat free damage.
edits.after: Rough stretch: Going Rogue's camouflage and Heroic Swing let him orbit your tentacles, dodging slams while stacking his passive shield. He pokes with Avengerang from 850 without entering your E range. You have no reveal — a Control Ward in the lane bush is what makes him fight you.

edits.before: Your spike: R Leap of Faith drops a tentacle wall that punishes his E Heroic Swing — if he swings into your field he takes stacked slams, and a landed E Test of Spirit means his low HP pool folds. Bait his swing then leap on top of him.
edits.after: Your spike: R Leap of Faith drops a tentacle per champion hit, and Heroic Swing is knocked off the moment it collides with a champion — stand in the arc. A landed Test of Spirit folds his HP pool, and running from the spirit makes him a Vessel.

edits.before: He keeps the edge through 4 by kiting: his swing dodges slams while his passive shield eats your Grasp, and you struggle to land E on a target that never stops moving.
edits.after: He keeps the edge through 4-5 by kiting; his swing dodges slams and his passive shield eats Grasp. Comeuppance stops on the first minion — never stand clear of the wave.

edits.before: Stand near tentacles to punish his orbit
edits.after: Body-block his swing to knock him off it

notes: Per the description-beats-flag rule I did not use the 'grounding' or 'untargetable' flags the kit carries on Leap of Faith — Riot's text says only damage plus a tentacle per champion hit. The mirror audit (akshan__illaoi) came to the same conclusion, so that flag pair looks like a tooltip-parse misfire on Illaoi's R across all her matchups. Note the mirror also recorded a 62.5%-over-24-games figure for its side, while this packet has 50.57% over 783 games; the 783-game number is the one I trusted. Left alone: diff is the enum 'EVEN' while diffRating is 7.5/10 and report[14] calls it 'Tricky' — a champion-level styling call, not a fact I can settle.
